verdict.rationale: Airbyte's docs have a dedicated MCP servers page. It states that MCP-capable agents such as Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT and Codex can connect to your data through Airbyte Agents, and a probe confirms the page exists. The broader docs also describe equipping agents to query, search and act on data in real time. Missing for 10: detail on the MCP server's tools, setup and authentication; clarity on whether it is first-party-hosted or community-maintained (the page sits under /community/); independent or hands-on corroboration.
